title: Mumbai → Singapore under ₹1,53,516 failed on a stale exchange rate
synopsis: tc-0001 failed the checker (Incorrect INR total: got 130949.18, expected 134999.04). The responsible step is fx/tool#1, confirmed by replay: 5/5 edited runs passed against 0/5 unchanged controls.

sequence_of_events.text: The planner parsed the request into constraints.
The FX tool returned a rate dated 2026-03-03.
The budget step multiplied by that rate.
The writer put the budget total into the plan.
The verifier passed the plan through unchanged.
The checker rejected the plan: Incorrect INR total: got 130949.18, expected 134999.04

probable_cause.text: The SGD to INR rate came from a snapshot months older than the rest of the run's data.

contributing_factors.text: Nothing downstream checks the age of the rate before using it.

findings.text: The exchange rate is 214 days older than the freshest data in this run.
The rate (54.4) is 15% below the rate used by the nearest passing run.
5 later steps consume this output, so a wrong value reaches the final plan.

verification.text: VERIFIED at K=5: fix 5/5 (95% interval 0.566 to 1.000) against control 0/5 (0.000 to 0.434).
